summary: Example task backs up the ICX config with icx_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up a Ruckus ICX config?

answer_card.title: Back up ICX config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (icx)
  community.network.icx_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_icx_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.icx'
```
